u: Three of the ten biggest under-billing issues are still happening: FedEx duty and VAT re-bills at District Vision, Izzy Zero Waste Beauty being charged below the USPS quote, and UPS currency losses at Pond Pro Canada. Together they added about $4.4K in the last 30 days.

USPS Package Type charges are the biggest single pattern: about $40K across Easy Clothes, Primo Golf Apparel, Wig Studio 1 and ENRFORCE. None have recurred since Sep 28, 2025, but the backlog was never billed.
Surcharge re-bills were reversed in one batch between May 14 and Jun 7, 2025, giving back about $23K at Easy Clothes and WESTON JON BOUCHÉR alone. Confirm whether that was intentional.
o: Freckled Poppy is the largest over-billing account: DHL eCommerce bills its labels below quote ($17K and still adding about $3K a month), and FirstMile surcharges re-billed to it came in higher than FirstMile's final charge ($15K).
Surcharge re-bills that ran ahead of the final carrier charge account for about $38K at Freckled Poppy, RESA and Girls Crew between Aug 2025 and Jan 2026. These merchants may be owed credits.
USPS postage fees on By Alexa Rae and Camp Snap add about $1.1K a month across roughly 93K labels. That is a pricing setting, not a billing error: confirm it is intended.
